exposure: systemic oxidative/nitrative stress (total peroxide level, total antioxidant capacity, nitrotyrosine level)
cohort: Healthy pregnant women were recruited at 12-13th gestational week.
finding: Lower systemic oxidative stress showed a correlation with high UtAPI measured between 12-13 weeks of gestation, and this was accompanied by significantly lower birth weight.
birth_weight: 3,317 ± 64 g (high UtAPI group) vs. 3,517 ± 77 g (low UtAPI group)
gest_age: UtAPI and stress markers measured at 12-13th gestational week
